channelSubscriptionConfigureServerOnly: Channel subscriptions can only be configured in a server.
channelSubscriptionInspectServerOnly: Channel subscriptions can only be inspected in a server.
channelSubscriptionManageServerOnly: Channel subscriptions can only be managed in a server.
channelSubscriptionRemoveServerOnly: Channel subscriptions can only be removed in a server.
reminderUnavailableFinished: **{title}** is already finished, so episode reminders would never fire. Search for the sequel/next season entry instead.
reminderUnavailableCancelled: **{title}** is cancelled, so episode reminders would never fire.
anilistUnavailable: AniList is temporarily unavailable. Anime and manga search should work again when its API is restored.
anilistRateLimited: AniList is receiving too many requests right now. Try the search again in a minute.
noHealthRecord: No health record has been recorded yet for {target} for **{title}**. The next worker poll will populate it.
channelSubscriptionSaved: {state, select, created {Subscribed} other {Updated subscription for}} <#{channelId}> to **{title}**.
personalSubscriptionSaved: {state, select, created {Subscribed you} other {Updated your subscription}} to **{title}**. Episode reminders will use DMs by default.
subscriptionAlreadyState: {target} for **{title}** are already {state, select, paused {paused} other {active}}.
buttonSubscriptionSaved: {state, select, created {Subscribed you} other {You are already subscribed}} to **{title}**. Use `/anime list` to view or unsubscribe.
